name: Shopify
needs: an app or a higher plan

invoices.text: VAT invoices for EU and UK orders with Shopify Tax; credit notes through an app

omnibus.text: Typed into the compare-at price by hand, says Shopify's help centre; or an app

withdrawal.text: Cancellations and returns from the customer account; a withdrawal form through an app

gpsr.text: Kept in product fields you fill in, says Shopify's help centre

vat.text: {{check}} Built in, with your OSS or IOSS registration

vies.text: {{check}} Built in with Shopify Tax, but not for B2B checkouts

b2b.text: {{check}} Built in on most plans; some parts on Plus only

stores.text: {{check}} Built in on any plan; more on Plus

preorders.text: Needs an app, says Shopify's help centre

tiered.text: Through an app, or Checkout Blocks on Plus

email.text: Through Shopify Messaging, Shopify's own app

reports.text: A weekly summary email built in; chosen reports through an app

ai.text: {{check}} Sidekick, included with every plan; features vary by plan

carriers.text: Through an app, such as Posten Bring's; built-in labels and pickup points cover other countries

strengths.text: You need an unusual tool: the App Store has over 16,000 apps
You also sell in physical shops: in-person selling comes with every plan
You want Shop Pay's quick checkout and the Shop app's shoppers
You want an AI assistant across the whole admin, by text, voice or screen sharing
You want to buy labels from Shopify itself, with no carrier agreement of your own, shipping from a country such as Germany or France

title: Kaizena Flow compared with Shopify

seo.title: Kaizena Flow vs Shopify: compared for EU shops
seo.description: How Kaizena Flow compares with Shopify for EU shops: the EU's rules, more ways to sell, AI, and what needs an app, checked on Shopify's own pages.

heroRest: The legal side of EU selling, more ways to sell and an AI that runs the shop come with Flow. Here is how it compares with Shopify, line by line.

faq.q: Can I move my Shopify shop to Flow?
faq.rest: Connect Shopify, copy your shop and press Move when you are happy. Products, customers, orders, your email list, gift cards and old links come with you.

faq.q: Do I need apps to get what the Flow column shows?
faq.rest: Everything in the Flow column is part of Flow. Owning several stores starts on the Grow plan.
Your store's database and servers are in Dublin, Ireland.

faq.q: Is it safe to let the AI work on its own?
faq.bold: You decide how much it does.
faq.rest: Refunds, emails to your whole list, changes to your staff and your domain always wait for your yes, and every change it makes is in the activity log.
